headline: Court Ruling Makes Lower Debit Interchange Fees Likely Following Legal Battle
summary: A court ruling makes it likely that the Federal Reserve will have to reduce its cap on debit interchange fees, though upcoming legal battles will determine the timing and implementation.
why: Interchange fee caps directly impact fee revenue for banks and payment networks while lowering transaction costs for merchants.

impacts.name: Banking and Payment Networks
impacts.why: Lower regulatory caps on debit interchange fees reduce fee income for card issuers and payment processors.
